pages.text: The $(d)Item Attraction Field$() Gene causes players to $(9)grab items from a much larger distance$().$(br2)This Gene is disabled when the player has an active $(l:geneticsresequenced:items/anti_field_orb)Anti-Field Orb$(/l), is near an active $(l:geneticsresequenced:blocks/anti_field_block)Anti-Field Block$(/l), or when sneaking.$(br2)This Gene $(c)cannot be given to mobs$().
